beforeImage.name: Gateway Fiber
beforeImage.description: Gateway Fiber builds and operates fiber-to-the-home broadband networks in the United States. Its customers are residential and small-business subscribers that purchase high-speed internet access over newly built fiber infrastructure. The business is asset-heavy because value depends on network construction, customer take-up, and recurring broadband subscriptions. Company materials state that Gateway Fiber was founded in 2019 and is based in Wright City, Missouri, while later transaction materials describe an expanded footprint after combining with other fiber platforms. Its principal operating footprint is in the United States. CBRE IM acquired Gateway Fiber in 2023 and announced a strategic merger of Gateway Fiber and WANRack in 2025.

afterImage.name: Gateway Fiber
afterImage.description: Gateway Fiber is a CBRE Investment Management-owned U.S. fiber-broadband platform serving residential and business subscribers, schools, municipalities and institutional customers. The platform builds and operates fiber-to-the-home networks and lit-fiber, dark-fiber, E-Rate, special-construction and private-WAN infrastructure. Gateway Fiber was founded in 2019; CBRE first entered the combined predecessor group through its July 2021 acquisition of WANRack and acquired Gateway Fiber in 2023. WANRack acquired KwiKom in 2023. CBRE announced the Gateway Fiber-WANRack combination in February 2025, and Gateway Fiber confirmed by July 29, 2025 that the merger was complete and the combined business operated under the Gateway Fiber umbrella. WANRack, LLC remains an active legal and education-facing operating brand presented as WANRack Powered by Gateway Fiber, while KwiKom's consumer operations use the Gateway Fiber brand. WANRack reported 232 fiber WANs in 23 states and CBRE described the combined platform as serving communities or schools across approximately 25 states. Grain Management's former controlling WANRack interest ended at the 2021 CBRE closing. CBRE remains the current controlling sponsor; exact current economics and fund or SMA names are not publicly disclosed. The March 2025 Phoenix asset sale was a partial divestiture, and 2026 transfers to GW Operating were internal reorganizations with unchanged ultimate ownership. No later external platform sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
